div.div:
Interaction is ManyToOne to Customer (optional = false, join column customer_id). The service resolves the customer first, links it, then saves the interaction in one unit of work.
No interaction read endpoints exist; customer delete has no cascade, so a customer with interactions cannot be removed cleanly (FK constraint).
